name: Judi Health (formerly Capital Rx, Inc.)
via: Founded in late 2017 by CEO AJ Loiacono and CTO Ryan Kelly; rebranded from Capital Rx, Inc. to Judi Health in September 2025 after a $400 million funding round led by Wellington Management and General Catalyst
note: Private, venture-backed US health-technology company (September 2025 valuation reported at $3.25bn by Forbes via Managed Healthcare Executive). The Capital Rx brand on NYCFC's right sleeve is its transparent-PBM offering; in July 2026 the company renamed that PBM brand Judi Rx (Judi Health press release, 2026-07-15). No state or state fund found among its disclosed investors; its named 2025 round participants were Wellington Management, General Catalyst, Generation Investment Management, Growth Equity at Goldman Sachs Alternatives, 9Yards Capital, B Capital, Edison Partners, Prime Health Investments and Transformation Capital (company release, 2025-09-23).
